detection_focus: Tasks running from user-writable paths (AppData, Temp, Public)
Unexpected task authors not matching Microsoft or installed software
Suspicious execution times (logon, startup, frequent intervals)
Tasks invoking cmd.exe, wscript.exe, cscript.exe, mshta.exe

flags.purpose: Displays all scheduled tasks with detailed properties including last run result, next run time, and scheduled command.
flags.security_use_case: Audit all scheduled tasks on system to identify persistence mechanisms and unauthorized scheduled executions.
flags.threat_detected: Malicious scripts or executables scheduled by malware for persistence; tasks running from suspicious paths.
flags.risk_if_misused: None; read-only. Large amount of output requires filtering.
flags.safe_followup: Examine task actions for suspicious paths or encoded commands; export results for baseline comparison.

flags.purpose: Deletes specified scheduled task from the system removing a persistence mechanism.
flags.security_use_case: Remove malware persistence by deleting scheduled task created by malicious software.
flags.risk_if_misused: Could delete legitimate tasks causing application failures; always verify before deletion.
flags.safe_followup: Document deleted task; investigate why it was created; ensure malware is fully removed.

flags.purpose: Creates new scheduled task with specified name, command to execute, schedule, and options.
flags.security_use_case: Create legitimate security monitoring tasks for regular system integrity checks.
flags.threat_detected: Attackers creating scheduled tasks for persistence or regular C2 callback.
flags.risk_if_misused: Creating unnecessary tasks increases attack surface; verify legitimate need before creation.
flags.safe_followup: Document all created tasks; monitor for unexpected new tasks.

flags.purpose: Modifies properties of existing scheduled task including enabled/disabled state, user context, and schedule.
flags.security_use_case: Disable suspicious scheduled task without deleting for preservation of evidence while preventing execution.
flags.risk_if_misused: Disabling task may alert attacker; investigate first.
flags.safe_followup: Investigate task source; examine task history; delete after analysis if confirmed malicious.

flags.purpose: Immediately runs scheduled task outside its normal schedule for immediate execution.
flags.security_use_case: Test newly created security monitoring tasks or manually execute legitimate scheduled jobs.
flags.threat_detected: Attackers manually triggering scheduled tasks to execute malicious commands.
flags.risk_if_misused: May cause system slowdown if task is resource-intensive; verify task legitimacy first.
flags.safe_followup: Monitor process creation logs and task output; check event logs for associated events.

flags.purpose: Stops currently running instance of scheduled task.
flags.security_use_case: Stop runaway or hijacked scheduled task consuming resources or performing malicious actions.
flags.risk_if_misused: May interrupt legitimate operations; may not stop already-executing process.
flags.safe_followup: Monitor for task restart; investigate why task was running unexpectedly; check for reinfection.

flags.purpose: Specifies output format - LIST, TABLE, or CSV - for scheduled task query results.
flags.security_use_case: Output as CSV for import into security tools or databases for analysis.
flags.risk_if_misused: None. Format selection depends on use case.
flags.safe_followup: Parse CSV output for automated analysis and alerting.

detection_queries.command: schtasks /Query /FO CSV /V | ConvertFrom-Csv | Where-Object {$_.'Task To Run' -match 'powershell|cscript|wscript|cmd\.exe|mshta'} | Select-Object 'TaskName','Last Run Time','Last Result','Task To Run'
detection_queries.why_powerful: Finds all scheduled tasks executing script interpreters and command processors commonly abused by malware.
detection_queries.security_context: Detecting fileless or obfuscated malware using legitimate Windows scripting binaries.

detection_queries.command: schtasks /Query /FO LIST /V | Findstr /i /C:"TaskName:" /C:"Task To Run:" /C:"Status:" /C:"Last Run Result:" | Findstr /i /V "OK Disabled"
detection_queries.why_powerful: Shows detailed properties of all active tasks for comprehensive manual review.
detection_queries.security_context: Baseline documentation and anomaly detection of scheduled task configuration.

detection_queries.command: schtasks /Query /FO CSV /V | ConvertFrom-Csv | Where-Object {$_.'Author' -notmatch 'Microsoft'} | Select-Object 'TaskName','Author','Task To Run'
detection_queries.why_powerful: Identifies tasks not authored by Microsoft which deserve additional scrutiny.
detection_queries.security_context: Spotting third-party or malicious scheduled tasks masquerading as system tasks.

tool_relationship.attacker_usage: schtasks is commonly used by malware and scripts to create persistence from command prompt or batch files.
tool_relationship.defender_usage: Primarily used for auditing, disabling, and removing malicious scheduled tasks when PowerShell is unavailable.
